title: Client walkthrough: Tom Reid, IT consultant

scenes.caption: Tom Reid: IT consultant, one account for everything
scenes.voice: Tom is a self-employed IT consultant. He uses one bank account for business and personal spending.

scenes.action: Statements and summary: about 120 lines, two statements
scenes.caption: Two statements, about 120 lines
scenes.voice: He sent two statements, about a hundred and twenty lines. The AI has already sorted them.

scenes.action: All tab: client fees as Business income; software and train fares as costs; hover reasons
scenes.caption: Income, costs, and why
scenes.voice: Client fees are business income. Software, train fares and his phone bill are costs. Each line says how it was sorted.

scenes.action: Please check (6): supermarket and takeaway lines → Personal / transfer — exclude from return
scenes.caption: Personal spending kept out
scenes.voice: Six lines need a person. Supermarket shopping and takeaways are personal, so Ade keeps them off the return.

scenes.action: Currys £640 line: Send question to Tom
scenes.caption: One question for Tom
scenes.voice: A six hundred and forty pound purchase at Currys could be a work laptop. Ade asks Tom rather than guess.

actions.value: Was the £640 to Currys on 12 May a work laptop?

scenes.action: Summary panel: Allowable expenses, Personal allowance, Income Tax, Class 4 NIC
scenes.caption: The figures, by rules
scenes.voice: The summary shows income, allowable expenses, Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance, all worked out by rules.

scenes.action: History panel: Review started, question sent
scenes.caption: Everything on record
scenes.voice: Every step is on the record: who reviewed, what was asked, and when.
